newsitem.title: UK: Scottish Pride calls receiver, talks stall.
newsitem.headline: Scottish Pride calls receiver, talks stall.

text.p: Scottish foods company Scottish Pride Holdings Plc, which earlier on Thursday requested its shares be suspended, said it had appointed receivers for its two main trading subsidiaries, Scottish Pride Ltd and Scottish Pride Foods Ltd, as talks to sell the assets were progressing slowly.
In a statement, the company said the receiver appointed was Blair Nimmo of KPMG Corporate Recovery.
"The company had been in discussions with a number of interested parties for the sale of its trading activities," the statement said.

"The request for the appointment of a receiver was made when, against a background of rapidly deteriorating trading, it became clear the company could not be confident that transactions for the sale of the activities would be achieved on satisfactory terms within a reasonable period of time," it said.

In a separate statement, Robert Wiseman Dairies Plc said that it had held discussions with Scottish Pride on a possible acquisition but "had not yet been able to agree commercially acceptable undertakings with the Office of Fair Trading".
